glassdoor.title: Systems Automation Engineer I
glassdoor.description: Overview: About RoviSys: RoviSys is an independent system integrator with year-over-year growth in Ireland, Europe, and world-wide. RoviSys provides a variety of information and automation services in many industries globally. RoviSys Ireland formed in 2022, with the Dublin Office open in May 2024. Dublin is part of RoviSys Europe group and currently operates closely with our European HQ located in Utrecht in The Nederland’s. RoviSys operates in 15+ markets areas and this leads to varied work experience with huge potential to develop and grow. About the opportunity: Systems Automation Engineer I is an entry level position responsible for designing and implementation of automation and process control systems for Life Science, Data Centre, Medical Devices, Food and Beverage and many other industrial sectors that RoviSys Europe operate in. Responsibilities: Key Responsibilities include: Assist in design and development of automation software tailored to customer project requirements. Work across multiple control systems and SCADA packages. Create and maintain design documentation. Assist in customer demonstrations and acceptance testing. Conduct electrical panel testing and Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT). Support site commissioning activities, including Site Acceptance Testing (SAT), Installation Qualification (IQ), and Operational Qualification (OQ). Assist with developing training documentation/presentation on operations and maintenance of system. Team & Work Environment: Typically, part of a project team of 2–5 engineers, led by an experienced colleague. Work will be split between the assigned RoviSys office and customer sites. Travel may be required depending on project needs. Qualifications: Experience Required: Graduate – 2 years’ experience Bachelor of Science (Level 8) in Engineering or Engineering Technology, Computer Science and/or equivalent qualification
glassdoor.company_description:
Since our founding, we’ve stood by simple principles. These have focused our vision and guided our success. Today, clients around the globe know RoviSys as a trustworthy partner that makes businesses stronger, more sustainable, and more profitable.

The most important thing we do is listen - because we’re committed to understanding your goals, your challenges, and your operations and delivering solutions with measurable results and clear return on investment.

We've earned a reputation of quality and continuity, built on technical expertise, attentive customer service, and a commitment to independence. We specialize in systems integration and advanced engineering solutions for a diverse range of global industries.
